_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbGpTJCNsaq61jSt8xxWSP4N)_

Refs #31112 (slice 1 of a per-skill split: item 4, objectstack-query only; the card stays open)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:objectstack-query 技能里 42 段 TypeScript 示例中,能独立成立的 20 段现在加了检查标记,CI 会把它们当真代码编译;其余 22 段(纯片段、故意写错的 ❌/✅ 对照)不标记,每个文件用一句话说明。
- 为什么改:AI 读技能写查询时照抄示例;以前这些示例没人编译,键名改了或被移除也不会报错。现在示例里写错键名、用已移除的键(如 `cursor`、`array_agg`)会在 CI 直接变红。
- 风险与回滚:只改技能文档,不动任何运行时代码;示例文字只多了两行类型声明或一行类型标注,教的规则不变。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`skills/objectstack-query/SKILL.md`(8 处标记与声明行)、`skills/objectstack-query/rules/pagination.md`(字面量改成带类型的 `const`)、`skills/objectstack-query/rules/filters.md`(token 余量为零,只换了一句开头)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:skill-examples`,预期最后一行为 `✅ 307 prose examples type-check across 3 surface(s)`。
- 需要你做的:受管面(skills/** 为 Tier H),请审阅后批准或亲手合并。

## What changes

- 20 of 42 fenced `ts`/`typescript` blocks in `skills/objectstack-query` now carry the opt-in `check:skill-examples` marker on the line above the fence.
- Engine-call blocks gain two lines, `import type { IDataEngine } from '@objectstack/spec/contracts';` and `declare const engine: IDataEngine;` (plus one `declare const` for a free variable in two blocks: `name`, `pageNumber`).
- Standalone query literals become `const NAME: QueryInput = { ... };` with `import type { QueryInput } from '@objectstack/spec/data';`.
- Left unmarked, said once per file: the bare `{ where: ... }` option fragments in `SKILL.md`; all seven `where` fragments in `rules/filters.md`; the ❌/✅ Common Mistakes pairs in `rules/aggregation.md` and `rules/pagination.md` (the ❌ half is wrong on purpose), plus pagination's OData `{ limit }` / `{ top }` pair and its REST request/response sketch.
- Example fixes: none. Every marked block compiled as written; no rule's teaching changed.

| File | marked / blocks before | after |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `SKILL.md` | 0 / 14 | 8 / 14 |
| `rules/aggregation.md` | 0 / 11 | 8 / 11 |
| `rules/filters.md` | 0 / 7 | 0 / 7 |
| `rules/pagination.md` | 0 / 10 | 4 / 10 |

### `skills/**` readings (repo `objectstack-ai/objectstack`, `origin/main` a61ddc93 vs this head)

| File | lines before → after | tokens before → after (ceiling) |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `SKILL.md` | 413 → 439 | 4329 → 4596 (5547) |
| `rules/aggregation.md` | 241 → 262 | 1860 → 2096 (2357) |
| `rules/filters.md` | 211 → 211 | 2477 → 2482 (2482) |
| `rules/pagination.md` | 206 → 215 | 1158 → 1289 (1382) |
| whole bundle, sum of every `SKILL.md` | 4566 → 4592 | 232095 → 233164 bytes |

No ceiling is raised. `filters.md` pays its one sentence by replacing its opening line ("Comprehensive guide for building ObjectStack query filters."), which carried no rule; `aggregation.md` and `pagination.md` replace their equivalent opening lines the same way.

## Tests

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:skill-examples` exit 0: `✅ 307 prose examples type-check across 3 surface(s) — every marked block parsed, so tsc ran the SEMANTIC pass on all of them`.
- Reverse check (committed first, restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, `git status --porcelain` empty after): planting `bogusKey: 1` in the SKILL.md search call, `cursor: 'abc'` in a pagination literal and `function: 'array_agg'` in an aggregation literal turned the gate red with exactly three diagnostics: TS2353 unknown key at `SKILL.md:326`, TS2322 on `array_agg` at `aggregation.md:154`, TS2322 on the retired `cursor` key at `pagination.md:132`.

## Acceptance notes

- `check:skill-examples` is not in this diff's derived gate list; it was run by hand (above).
- `filters.md` now sits at token headroom 0, so the next edit there must pay in the same file.

## Verification

Derived gates for this diff (46 commands, `dispatch-gates --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`) are listed with exit codes in the report comment on the card.
